Method: Median of repetition medians, microseconds per iteration. Rotating module order. Fresh fixtures, full GC after setup. Setup/GC/verify/cleanup excluded; callback work included. All modules compiled at O2 with matching codegen request; native compilation of every function is not guaranteed. Lexical task injection, no custom environment. Avg uses only the seven workloads supported by all four modules.

Workloads.ConnectAndDisconnect: Connect + Disconnect on an existing empty signal
Workloads.CreateAndFire: New + store signal + Connect + Fire; cleanup excluded
Workloads.FireManyArguments: Fire with 32 numbers; one listener checks argument count and sums all values
Workloads.FireYieldingHandler: One Fire + handler coroutine.yield + suspension assertion + task.spawn resume; not frame latency
Workloads.WaitOnEvent: Create/store/start waiter coroutine + Wait subscription + Fire + waiter completion
